subject: May Institute Essentials online is accepting applications!

messages.author: 2889aa2e61425c8e
messages.subject: May Institute Essentials online is accepting applications!
parts:
Dear MSstats Community: This year we are piloting May Institute Essentials: a mini and super concise version of the original May Institute program, fully online. The discussions will cover the core concepts of MSstats for mass spectrometry, lead by the original developers of the tools. Expect tutorial lectures, live case, studies, and 1:1 office hours for extra discussion, brainstorm or debug.

Please mark your calendar, and share with anyone who may benefit or be interested. Register at https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/ and please share widely

Sincerely
Olga Vitek
Raymond Bradford Bradstreet Professor
Director, Barnett Institute for Chemical and Biological Analysis
Khoury College of Computer Sciences
Northeastern University
